title: Early Versus Delayed Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Following ERCP in Concomitant Gallstones and Common Bile Duct Stones
brief_summary: The present study aimed to compare early and delayed laparoscopic cholecystectomy after ERCP for CBDs and gallstones.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients who underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy after clearance of CBDs by ERCP

Exclusion Criteria:

* advanced liver cirrhosis, pancreatitis, acute cholangitis, suspected malignancy, severe malnutrition, and pregnancy.
